passives.description:
Every {1} seconds:
- $TimeStop all enemies in range for {2} seconds (Maximum {5} times per enemy)
During $TimeStop:
- This unit applies $Fire on attack
- $Fire deals {3}% increased damage per tick (Capacity: {4}%)
- All currently applied $DoT have their durations paused until $TimeStop ends (Enemies can be afflicted by additional $DoT during this)
